cycles.method: verify_bounds.py: 732 conservative source-word/call units per sample including split setup, separate reachable left/right ring paths. benchmark.py: 394.625 observed net executed instructions/sample on both cores, cold/warm history, fixed/moving controls and all splits 0..15. Initialization is separate; chip timing is unmeasured.

stock.justification: Preserves all original sine values and the full stereo sweep while protecting live stock shared words. 1.257 times matched Spring, 1.347 times stock Chorus; 17.2% above prior beta 336.75 and 24.8% below original 0.1.0. Lossless packing reduces shared P storage from 1425 to 795 words per core. The modeled four-instance split block with initialization is 47256 units. No physical timing or headroom is established.

scope: 31-second native DSP-only replay of three tempo-derived LFO target streams per instance (120 BPM; 1/2/4-beat periods), rapid endpoint locks and 12 parameter-byte targets each step. Only SPD/RNG/MIX have an audible path; other slots are inactive. Both cores, four independent rings each, 0.98-FS bursts plus tones, dirty state and local/shared canaries. ColdFire sequencer/LFO, scenes, MIDI, transport, project and physical timing are not tested.
